title: Proof Registry Problem (RFC 7807)
description: RFC 7807 Problem Details payload emitted by the registry on errors. Served with Content-Type: application/problem+json.

type.description: Absolute URI identifying the problem class. Stable across releases; safe to consume programmatically as a discriminator.

status.description: HTTP status code, mirrored from the response status line per RFC 7807 §3.1.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary; constant per type.

detail.description: Per-occurrence human description with specific information about this instance.

code.description: Non-standard extension: the legacy short machine-readable error key (e.g. "not_found"). Per RFC 7807 §3.2, additional members are allowed.
